CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Real per-platform (Windows/Linux/macOS) editor-demo binaries now attached to every GitHub Release; releases switched from --prerelease to regular. Fixed 3 real compiler/CI bugs found via live cross-platform CI (SDL2main Windows link, macOS SDL_ttf.h include, and a general emit.c uninitialized-match-result gap + unused-constructor warnings only Clang catches). v0.69.0 (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
